connector.name: Kira
connector.registryDescription: Skills and Scars for AI agents - your agent records its failures and never repeats them.
connector.summary: Runs locally from the npm package kira-mcp. The credential requirement is not named, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the aibenyclaude-coder account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: The record marks at least one value as secret without naming the scheme. Read the source before you supply a credential.

env.name: KIRA_TELEMETRY
env.description: Override telemetry consent level for the process: off | basic | full. Default: basic on first run, with detail (note/context) gated by explicit opt-in. Full wire format and redaction rules in PRIVACY.md.

env.name: KIRA_TELEMETRY_URL
env.description: Override the telemetry ingest endpoint. Default: https://kira-telemetry.workers.dev/v1/reports.

env.name: KIRA_HOME
env.description: Where consent state and the local report log live. Default: ~/.kira

env.name: KIRA_PRO_KEY
env.description: Optional ES256-signed JWT for the Kira Pro tier (real-time skill/scar updates from CDN). Free tier works without this.
